topic: Intellectual Disability: Learning Needs and Primary-Level Support
subject: Auto-detect
concepts_taught: Intellectual Disability as limitations in intellectual functioning and adaptive behaviour
intellectual functioning: reasoning, learning and problem solving
adaptive behaviour: everyday, social and practical skills
repetition, consistent vocabulary and guided practice
reading, language and mathematics classroom support
adaptive conceptual, social and practical skills
teacher observation, progress monitoring and inclusive participation
misconceptions_used: intellectual disability means only low intelligence
low marks automatically prove intellectual disability
the same support should be used for every learner
the teacher should do every task for the child
inclusion means only physical presence in the classroom
examples_used: Class 2 Riya using counters to learn quantity and numerals
Arjun learning a bag-packing routine through stepwise modelling
primary learner using visual cues for two-step instructions
concrete counting materials and number representations
sources: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2016 — India Code
NCERT Guidance and Counselling for the Intellectually Disabled
NCERT Guidelines for e-Content for Students with Intellectual Disabilities
